visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a black ponytail, wearing a dark tank top and blue athletic leggings, is seen from a high-angle perspective climbing an extremely steep, nearly vertical wooden ladder. The ladder is constructed of rough timber slats tied with thick ropes, ascending a lush, green mountain slope shaded by a dense forest canopy. (2) The scene transitions to a man walking through a bright, sun-dappled forest filled with tall, thin trees and a thick undergrowth of ferns and tropical plants. A hand appears in a close-up, pointing to a green information map on a wooden stand, indicating a specific location along a trail. (3) A sweeping drone shot captures a prominent green mountain peak under a clear, bright blue sky. In the foreground, white pampas grass sways gently in the breeze. The woman stands on a grassy plateau with her back to the camera, looking towards the mountain. (4) The camera shifts back to a close-up of the woman climbing the wooden ladder, emphasizing her gloved hands gripping the guide ropes for stability. She carefully places her feet on the wooden steps, looking down momentarily to ensure her balance while navigating the steep, challenging ascent in the forest. (5) A man and woman are seen standing in front of a natural rock overhang or shallow cave. The cave opening is framed by rugged rock textures and greenery. Below the cliff, a simple wooden bench is placed on a dirt clearing. The lighting is natural and clear. (6) Further exploration sequences show the woman walking along a narrow forest trail lined with rope railings. She passes an old stone monument with Chinese inscriptions. Additional shots reveal dark, mossy rock crevices and cave interiors, followed by wide aerial views of the forested ridge and distant city buildings.
